rules.teach_response: right -> praise_first_*; 1st wrong -> again_* + teach_<letter>, listen again; 2nd wrong -> moveon_* (no praise), next item; silence -> nohear_* and listen once more, a second silence moves on (teach turns never hold the child back or change mastery)
rules.quiz_silence: silence -> nohear_* and listen again; a second silence counts as a wrong attempt
rules.quiz_attempts: 1st wrong -> tryagain_* + hint_<letter> (after a double silence: hint only); 2nd wrong -> teach_<letter> as the reveal, child repeats, item goes to the retry round
rules.retry_round: items missed in the quiz are asked once more after retry_intro; still wrong -> left unmastered for the next session
rules.mastered_when: correct in the quiz or retry round
